alpnProtocol: The negotiated ALPN protocol as a string, or `null` if no protocol was negotiated.
createServer: Creates a TLS server that listens for TCP connections and wraps them with TLS. Incoming connections are emitted as `'connection'` events with a `tls.Socket` instance. Options are the same as `tls.Socket`, plus any options supported by <https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-net>.
createConnection: Creates a TCP connection and wraps it with TLS. `opts` are passed to both the underlying TCP socket and `TLSSocket`. At minimum, `port` must be specified.
TLSSocket: A duplex stream that wraps another duplex stream with TLS; the underlying stream handles transport while the TLS socket handles encryption and decryption.
TLSSocket.constructor: Wrap the duplex stream `socket` with TLS.
TLSSocketEvents.connect: Emitted when the TLS handshake completes.
TLSSocketOptions.isServer: Whether the socket acts as a TLS server or client; if `true`, `cert` and `key` must be provided. Defaults to `false`.
TLSSocketOptions.cert: A `Buffer` containing PEM-encoded certificate data. Defaults to `null`.
TLSSocketOptions.key: A `Buffer` containing PEM-encoded private key data. Defaults to `null`.
TLSSocketOptions.host: The hostname to verify the server certificate against; DNS names are also sent as the SNI extension, while IP literals are matched against the certificate's IP SANs with SNI suppressed. Required for client sockets unless `rejectUnauthorized` is `false`.
TLSSocketOptions.rejectUnauthorized: Whether the client rejects connections when certificate verification fails. Defaults to `true`.
TLSSocketOptions.ca: A `Buffer` of one or more PEM-encoded CA certificates; when provided, only these CAs are used for verification instead of the bundled Mozilla root certificates. Defaults to `null`.
TLSSocketOptions.alpnProtocols: An array of ALPN protocol name strings, ordered by preference. Defaults to `null`.
TLSSocketOptions.eagerOpen: Whether to open the stream eagerly. Defaults to `true`.
TLSSocketOptions.allowHalfOpen: Whether to allow half-open connections. Defaults to `true`.
TLSSocketOptions.readBufferSize: The size in bytes of the read buffer. Defaults to `65536`.
TLSNetServer: A TLS server over TCP; incoming connections are wrapped with TLS and emitted as `'connection'` events.
TLSNetServer.listening: Whether or not the server is listening.
TLSNetServerEvents: Events emitted by a TLS server.
TLSNetServerEvents.listening: Emitted when the server starts listening.
TLSNetServerEvents.connection: Emitted when a new TLS connection is established.
constants: Internal state flags used by `TLSSocket`, such as `state.CONNECTED`.
errors: The `TLSError` class, thrown for failed TLS operations.
errors.from: Create a `TLSError` from `err`, copying its message and code.
TLSError: An error produced by a failed TLS operation; `code` identifies the failure.
TLSError.from: Create a `TLSError` from `err`, copying its message and code.
